description.narrative: The overall objective of this project is to improve the effectiveness of bilateral official development providers’ cooperation and development finance, including the European Union, in a rapidly evolving geopolitical landscape. Work under this partnership will be delivered by: (1) conducting policy-relevant research and comparative analysis to create a body of work that is evidence-based, responsive to, and representative of, the policy needs and issues related to future-proofing development cooperation and European development finance; and (2) strategic convenings and events, bringing together and engaging with a network of relevant stakeholders to facilitate discussions, peer learning, and ensuring that CGD Europe’s research is informed by different perspectives and political realities. Further details about the research themes and specific deliverables are provided in section 3.
